UDP socket tile for RX/TX batching, packet framing, and metrics.

# Purpose
This file implements the `sock` tile for the Firedancer network pipeline. It is a C source file that defines the tile life cycle, memory layout, file descriptor policy, and packet processing callbacks used by `fd_stem.c`. The tile bridges UDP sockets and the internal fragment flow: it receives UDP packets from several configured listen ports, adds Ethernet, IPv4, and UDP headers, and publishes the packets into the network links used by other tiles. It also takes outgoing fragments from the internal links, strips the network headers, and sends the payloads with `sendmmsg` through a raw UDP transmit socket.

The file contains both privileged and unprivileged setup code. In [`privileged_init`](<#privileged_init>), it creates and binds the receive sockets, sets socket options such as `SO_REUSEPORT`, `IP_PKTINFO`, and buffer sizes, and creates the raw transmit socket. In [`unprivileged_init`](<#unprivileged_init>), it connects the tile to the topology links and validates link types and burst sizes. The file also defines the RX and TX fast paths, batch buffers, metrics updates, seccomp and file descriptor allow lists, and the `fd_tile_sock` tile descriptor that exports the tile interface to the rest of the system.
